revisions.name: unequal_reaction_yield
revisions.rationale: The small, sign-changing mean residuals may reflect slightly unequal consumption of u and production of v rather than missing memory or another field. This is the smallest two-field revision.
revisions.falsification_intervention: Apply equal localized positive pulses to v at two amplitudes under otherwise identical periodic conditions; falsify this revision if the integrated extra u loss and v gain remain equal across amplitudes while the residuals persist.

revisions.name: weak_cubic_v_loss
revisions.rationale: The pulsed condition ends with v below baseline while u remains slightly above it, consistent with a weak density-dependent v sink that becomes most visible after a v pulse.
revisions.falsification_intervention: Repeat the localized v pulse at several amplitudes; falsify this revision if the late negative v residual does not grow more than proportionally with pulse amplitude.

revisions.name: reversible_inactive_v_pool
revisions.rationale: The alternating v mean residual after the pulse suggests a small delayed redistribution of v through an unobserved, weakly diffusing pool, while preserving the public reaction term.
revisions.falsification_intervention: Deliver two identical localized v pulses separated by a variable delay; falsify this revision if the response to the second pulse has no delay-dependent recovery signature.
